\documentclass[8pt,landscape,a4paper,oneside]{article}
\usepackage[utf8]{inputenc}
\usepackage{multicol}
\usepackage[landscape,margin=0.3in]{geometry}
\usepackage{xcolor}
\usepackage{titlesec}
\usepackage{listings}
\usepackage{fancyhdr}
\usepackage{longtable,booktabs,array}
\usepackage{calc}
\usepackage{etoolbox}
% Pandoc emits \texorpdfstring{}{} for any heading containing inline formatting
% (e.g. "## Concurrency (`pn` only)"); that macro comes from hyperref. Without
% it the build fails on an undefined control sequence — this predates the table
% work and is why the committed PDF had gone stale.
\usepackage[hidelinks]{hyperref}

% Pandoc emits every pipe table as a `longtable`, but longtable is a
% page-breaking environment and cannot appear inside `multicols`, which wraps
% this whole sheet. Map it onto a plain `tabular` that flows inside a column,
% and neutralise longtable's head/foot markers, which tabular does not know.
% Pandoc's form is \begin{longtable}[]{<colspec>}, so the optional argument is
% absorbed and only the column spec is handed to tabular.
\makeatletter
\renewenvironment{longtable}[2][]{%
  \setlength{\LTleft}{0pt}\setlength{\LTright}{0pt}%
  \begin{tabular}{#2}%
}{%
  \end{tabular}%
}
\def\endhead{}
\def\endfirsthead{}
\def\endfoot{}
\def\endlastfoot{}
\makeatother

% Tables must fit a narrow 3-column sheet: shrink the type and tighten padding.
\AtBeginEnvironment{tabular}{\fontsize{6.5}{8}\selectfont}
\setlength{\tabcolsep}{2pt}
\renewcommand{\arraystretch}{1.0}
% booktabs pads generously around every rule. With ~50 tables on the sheet that
% padding alone runs to most of a page, so drive it to zero.
\setlength{\aboverulesep}{0pt}
\setlength{\belowrulesep}{0pt}
\setlength{\abovetopsep}{0pt}
\setlength{\belowbottomsep}{0pt}
\setlength{\defaultaddspace}{2pt}
% With the header row suppressed, pandoc's \toprule lands directly under the
% group label and reads as a divider between the two. Drop it; \midrule and
% \bottomrule still close the table off below.
% With the header suppressed, pandoc's \toprule lands directly under the group
% label and reads as a divider between the two. booktabs' rule macros open an
% \noalign that they close themselves, so they cannot be wrapped or expanded
% away without misplacing the \noalign pandoc emits next — set the thickness
% they draw at instead. \midrule keeps \lightrulewidth for the few tables that
% still carry a header.
\setlength{\heavyrulewidth}{0pt}

% Configure listings for code blocks - breakable across columns
\lstset{
  basicstyle=\fontsize{7.5}{9}\ttfamily,
  backgroundcolor=\color{shadecolor},
  breaklines=true,
  breakatwhitespace=false,
  columns=fullflexible,
  keepspaces=true,
  frame=none,
  aboveskip=1pt,
  belowskip=1pt,
  xleftmargin=3pt,
  xrightmargin=3pt,
  commentstyle=\color[rgb]{0.56,0.35,0.01}\itshape,
  keywordstyle=\color[rgb]{0.13,0.29,0.53}\bfseries,
  stringstyle=\color[rgb]{0.31,0.60,0.02},
  showstringspaces=false,
  tabsize=2,
  literate={á}{{\'a}}1 {é}{{\'e}}1 {í}{{\'i}}1 {ó}{{\'o}}1 {ú}{{\'u}}1
}

% Configure page numbering and footer
\pagestyle{fancy}
\fancyhf{} % Clear all header and footer fields
\fancyfoot[C]{\thepage} % Center page number in footer
\renewcommand{\headrulewidth}{0pt} % Remove header rule
\renewcommand{\footrulewidth}{0pt} % Remove footer rule

% Prevent blank pages
\raggedbottom
\let\cleardoublepage\clearpage

% Better page breaking and orphan/widow control
\setlength{\columnsep}{15pt}
\raggedcolumns
\widowpenalty=10000
\clubpenalty=10000

% Prevent premature column/page breaks in multicol
\setlength{\multicolsep}{0pt}
\setlength{\premulticols}{1pt}
\setlength{\postmulticols}{1pt}
\setlength{\multicolbaselineskip}{0pt}

% Define colors for shaded environments
\definecolor{shadecolor}{rgb}{0.95,0.95,0.95}

% Define tightlist for pandoc
\providecommand{\tightlist}{%
  \setlength{\itemsep}{0pt}\setlength{\parskip}{0pt}}

% Define passthrough for inline code with listings
\newcommand{\passthrough}[1]{#1}

% Configure page with tighter spacing
\setlength{\parindent}{0pt}
\setlength{\parskip}{1pt}
\setlength{\topsep}{0pt}
\setlength{\partopsep}{0pt}

% Configure multicol
\setlength{\columnsep}{15pt}
\setlength{\columnseprule}{0.2pt}

% Configure sections - make them slightly bigger and more compact
\titleformat{\section}[block]{\normalfont\Large\bfseries}{}{0pt}{}
\titlespacing*{\section}{0pt}{10pt plus 2pt minus 1pt}{1pt plus 1pt minus 1pt}

\titleformat{\subsection}[block]{\normalfont\large\bfseries}{}{0pt}{}
\titlespacing*{\subsection}{0pt}{9pt plus 2pt minus 1pt}{0pt plus 1pt minus 1pt}

% Don't print section numbers
\setcounter{secnumdepth}{0}

% Custom commands for compact lists
\newenvironment{compactlist}{
    \begin{list}{\textbullet}{\setlength{\itemsep}{0pt}\setlength{\parskip}{0pt}\setlength{\parsep}{0pt}}
}{\end{list}}

\begin{document}

% Title
\begin{center}
{\Large \textbf{Lambda Script Cheatsheet}}
\end{center}
\vspace{-8pt}
\begin{flushright}
{\small Jan 2026 - v0.2}
\end{flushright}

\vspace{3pt}

% Start 3-column layout
\begin{multicols*}{3}
\raggedright
$body$
\end{multicols*}

\end{document}
